headline: [Rare Shutdown!] US Grounds Flights Nationwide for [4+ Hours]
sub: Air traffic communication failure halts departures
caption:
✈️ Rare Shutdown: US Grounds Flights Nationwide for 4+ Hours

The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) stopped flights from taking off at all US airports on Friday afternoon, after a communication problem hit air traffic control centres across the country. Departures were halted for more than four hours before the FAA lifted the order late Friday.

🔹 The FAA said the ground stop was ordered "for reasons of safety" after "communication issues" at multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers. Technicians are still looking into the cause.
🔹 By Friday evening, FlightAware showed more than 1,900 flights cancelled and over 10,000 delayed in the US. Delays are expected to continue.
🔹 Officials said there was no sign of a "nefarious" act. It was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023.
